atlases.a:
Use case: stylized-concept. Batch 64 Atlas A: eight GM-requested white glyph revisions and one new feat.
Reference sheet cells 1–8 contain the EXACT saved GM-selected candidates at the matching positions. Preserve useful silhouettes while applying each instruction. Cell 9 is intentionally blank and receives the NEW Barbarka glyph. Samuraj is a complete redesign according to the latest instruction: no scabbard. The second reference is STYLE ONLY; do not copy its subjects.
ONE complete square 3x3 atlas with exactly nine equal square cells, strict row-major order. One independent centered white UI glyph per cell. Every subject must fit fully within the middle 60% of its cell; reserve at least 20% blank margin on EACH side. Entire heads, caps, blades, hands and limbs must be complete and uncropped. No grid lines, borders, lettering, logos, numerals, labels or watermark.
Pure solid WHITE #FFFFFF glyph shapes on pure solid BLACK #000000 background. Serious minimal flat stencil/vector silhouettes matching dnd5e interface icons. Broad functional shapes, restrained structural negative space, readable at 16/24/32px. No shading, gradients, tiny texture, distress, scratches, grunge, speckles, hatching or decorative badges. No gore. Use anatomically believable adult hands and bodies, never cartoon gloves or toy proportions.
ROW-MAJOR CONTENTS:
1. wychuchana_spluwa_revision_d: Keep exactly two realistic gloved hands, the holding grip and the cleaning cloth. Lengthen the pistol slide/barrel to adult-handgun proportions, about 25% longer than the short draft. Draw one unmistakable curved trigger INSIDE its complete trigger guard, with a broad black gap around it. No third hand, floating trigger or extra guard.
2. samuraj_revision_c: Completely redraw according to the GM's new direction: one realistic adult hand grips a KATANA with a gently curved single-edged blade and plain circular guard, blade diagonal up-right. The OFF HAND is empty and held beside it in a compact martial guard position, fingers naturally extended together and palm angled toward the viewer. Exactly two anatomically correct hands, one katana. NO scabbard, draw gesture, sleeves shaped like hands, extra weapon or armoured figure.
3. bebeszenie_revision_c: Keep the crossed butcher knife and pliers in front of the rib outline. Repair the pliers: two straight continuous handles below the pivot, no V-shaped kink, hooked grip or bent handle. Two recognisable open jaws above the pivot. Only these TWO tools form the X; no extra tool or gore.
4. szabrowanie_revision_c: Preserve the crowbar levering at the front lip of the crate, but make its flattened hooked working tip distinct from the crate wall, with a broad black separation contour around the tip apart from its small real contact/fulcrum. The crowbar must not fuse with the crate. Enlarge the raised rectangular lid to clearly cover the whole crate when closed, with visible hinges and a large coherent slab.
5. chodzmy-na-pewno-juz-utonal_revision_b: Keep the underwater swimmer, head, front arms, waterline and air bubble. Rebuild the rear half as a natural human pelvis and exactly TWO proportional human legs: one leg trails straight behind, the other bends gently at a single knee, both ending in recognisable feet. No fused hips, extra legs, backwards knees, fins or animal parts.
6. gambling-we-krwi_revision_b: Keep the barter trader, offered canteen, second hand and goods crate. Zoom out enough that the full cap and head are complete, with generous empty space above them. No flat cropped crown, clipped cap or missing shoulders. Preserve the useful barter gesture.
7. zjadlem-wlasnego-psa_revision_b: Reframe to show the COMPLETE head and menacing face of the rugged butcher, upper torso and apron. Raise the hand holding a heavy short-handled butcher's axe/hatchet to beside the shoulder, with the entire blade visible. Focus on the stern face, broad shoulders and raised tool; no clipped skull, cropped blade, dog or gore.
8. hi-tech_revision_b: Preserve the electronic console with broad control, traces and two buttons. Replace the cartoon oversized glove/finger with an anatomically plausible adult hand in a close-fitting plain work glove: normal-sized palm, four proportional fingers, a distinct thumb, one straight index finger presses the large control. No inflated cartoon glove, mitten, giant cuff or extra finger.
9. barbarka (NEW): One rugged fighter delivers a headbutt: two human head-and-shoulder profiles meet forehead to forehead with one broad impact burst between them. Two intact skulls, no gore or tiny detail.
Make the changes visible: full uncropped cap/head in cell 6, full menacing head and raised axe in cell 7, natural rather than cartoon hand in cell 8. Inspect cell 2 for exactly two hands, only one katana, no scabbard. In cell 3 each pliers handle is straight, not kinked. In cell 4 the pry tip is visually separated from the crate.

ROW-MAJOR CONTENTS:
1. Bez trzymanki: One rider balances a practical motorcycle with BOTH hands clearly off its handlebars, arms held out in a controlled riding posture. One coherent bike, two wheels, broad simple frame; no stunt circus pose or tiny mechanics.
2. Benzyna zamiast krwi: One alert driver grips a steering wheel and protects a compact car silhouette from a single incoming impact. The driver's broad shoulder blocks the impact near the car. Show vehicle protection through practical shapes, no heart, blood, logos or floating cog.
3. Ciszej niż cień: One crouched survivor moves quietly close to a low broken wall, boot lifted lightly above the ground. Its broad shadow contour stays close behind. A spare stealth silhouette, no crossed-out alarm, speech bubble or tiny footprints.
4. Człowiek-pająk: One practical wasteland climber climbs a near-vertical wall using two hands and two boots, a plain rope hanging nearby. Clear bent limbs and one firm handhold. Ordinary gear, no superhero costume, spider emblem or recognizable fictional character.
5. Fabrykator: Two sturdy hands assemble a compact device clamped in a bench vise, one hand steadies the piece while the other tightens a large bolt with a wrench. Broad real workshop shapes, no generic giant cog or toy exploded stack.
6. Fachowiec: Two capable hands hold two different real tools over a spare workbench: a wrench in one and pliers in the other. Balanced practical tool silhouettes with broad open space, no third tool or decorative badges.
7. Grenadier: One athletic survivor immediately throws a retrieved grenade with an outstretched arm and one broad throw arc; one plain grenade at the end of the arc. Clear complete hand and grenade silhouette, no explosion or instructions.
8. Immunitet: One large plain medical shield with a broad cross blocks three simple disease-particle blobs outside it. Crisp joined shield shape and restrained negative space, no tiny plus marks, letters or gore.
9. Jest zajebiście: One confident charismatic survivor raises an open hand while addressing two attentive allies shown as small shoulder silhouettes. A clear encouraging speech posture, no text-filled speech bubble, medals or floating symbols.
Keep object and limb counts physically coherent. Both rider hands are OFF the handlebars in cell 1. The gloves must have natural proportions. Simple actual tools replace generic oversized cogs.

2. Kuloodporność: One broad bare unarmoured torso leans away as a single bullet skims harmlessly along its side with one short curved streak. Strong shoulder and chest outline, no armour plates, shield, blood or superhero costume.

These are generic post-apocalyptic skills, not portraits of recognizable franchise characters. Cell 8 is an ordinary survivor evading a bullet, no movie resemblance. Show exactly two hands/two knives in cell 9. Keep guitar and melee hands complete in their own cells.
